content.content:
## Pricing Tiers

| Plan | Monthly price | Included emails | Overage cost | Data retention |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0.00 | 100/month | Not allowed | 45 days |
| Basic | $15.00 | 10,000/month | $1.80 per 1,000 | 45 days |
| Pro (Most Popular) | $16.50 | 10,000/month | $1.30 per 1,000 | Up to 365 days (45-day default) |
| Platform | $18.00 | 10,000/month | $1.20 per 1,000 | Up to 365 days (45-day default) |

## Add-ons

- **Dedicated IPs:** Starting at $50/month per IP. Intended for senders of 300,000+ emails/month, and available only on Pro or higher.
- **Custom activity retention:** Starting at $5/month. Available only on Pro or higher. Statistics are kept indefinitely.
- **DMARC monitoring:** Starting at $14/month per domain.

## Deliverability Features

- Industry-leading deliverability rates and speed, listed on the paid plans
- High-quality, vetted IPs
- DKIM, SPF, and DMARC authentication
- Automatic suppression management
- Granular bounce data
- Delivery, bounce, spam, and open rate reporting
- Email open and link tracking
- Multi-region routing (SMTP)
- Delivery statistics shared on a public status page
- A claim of delivery speeds "up to 4x faster" than other providers, which is unverified

## Notes

- The page is inconsistent about custom retention for Basic. The comparison table says it is available as an add-on, but the add-on section says Pro or higher only.
- Some feature checkmarks in the comparison table did not extract, so per-tier availability of those features can't be confirmed from this content.

## Transactional Plans

| Plan | Price | Emails/mo | Overage (per 1,000) | Daily limit | Domains | Webhook endpoints | Data retention | Dedicated IPs | SSO |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | 3,000 | None | 100/day | 3 | 1 | 30 days | No | No |
| Pro | $20 | 50,000 | $0.90 | No limit | 10 | 5 | 30 days | No | No |
| Pro | $35 | 100,000 | $0.90 | No limit | 10 | 5 | 30 days | No | No |
| Scale | $90 | 100,000 | $0.90 | No limit | 1,000 | 10 | 30 days | Add-on ($30/mo) | Add-on ($150/mo) |
| Scale | $160 | 200,000 | $0.80 | No limit | 1,000 | 10 | 30 days | Add-on ($30/mo) | Add-on ($150/mo) |
| Scale | $350 | 500,000 | $0.70 | No limit | 1,000 | 10 | 30 days | Add-on ($30/mo) | Add-on ($150/mo) |
| Scale | $650 | 1,000,000 | $0.65 | No limit | 1,000 | 10 | 30 days | Add-on ($30/mo) | Add-on ($150/mo) |
| Scale | $825 | 1,500,000 | $0.52 | No limit | 1,000 | 10 | 30 days | Add-on ($30/mo) | Add-on ($150/mo) |
| Scale | $1,150 | 2,500,000 | $0.46 | No limit | 1,000 | 10 | 30 days | Add-on ($30/mo) | Add-on ($150/mo) |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | Custom | No limit | Flexible | Flexible | Flexible | Add-on | Included |

- Dedicated IPs on Scale are available only to customers sending more than 3,000 emails per day.
- Enterprise is listed with dedicated IPs as an add-on in the comparison table, but the Enterprise section says they're included. The page doesn't resolve this.
- Enterprise adds a 99.99% uptime SLA and enterprise rate limits.

## Marketing Plans

| Plan | Price | Contacts/mo |
|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | 1,000 |
| Pro marketing | $40 | 5,000 |
| Pro marketing | $80 | 10,000 |
| Pro marketing | $120 | 15,000 |
| Pro marketing | $180 | 25,000 |
| Pro marketing | $250 | 50,000 |
| Pro marketing | $450 | 100,000 |
| Pro marketing | $650 | 150,000 |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom |

Marketing plans are capped by contacts, not sends.

## Add-ons and Pay-as-you-go

- **Domains:** $20/mo for 100 more domains (Pro and Scale).
- **Inboxes:** $1 per inbox per month on paid plans with pay-as-you-go.
- **Automation runs:** 10,000 included on all paid plans. Beyond that, $0.0015 per run.

## Deliverability and Reliability Features

- **Custom domains:** 3 (Free), 10 (Pro), 1,000 (Scale), flexible (Enterprise).
- **Shared IPs:** Monitored and maintained shared IPs on all plans.
- **Dedicated IPs:** Scale add-on ($30/mo), with automatic warmup, monitoring, and autoscaling. Enterprise also offers them.
- **Automatic suppression list:** Permanently bounced addresses are added automatically, on all plans.
- **Bounce details:** Root-cause information for soft and hard bounces, on all plans.
- **Deliverability insights:** Available on all plans. Personalized deliverability expertise starts at Pro.
- **DKIM, SPF, DMARC:** Authentication on all plans.
- **Multi-region sending:** Choose the sending region, on all plans.
- **Data retention:** 30 days on Free through Scale. Flexible on Enterprise.
- **Webhooks:** Signed payloads on all plans. Endpoint limits vary by tier.

content.text:
**Recommendation: Resend for most new projects. Choose Postmark if inbox placement and delivery speed matter more than cost.**

Both vendors' pricing pages were fetched today (2026-10-16). Postmark's page didn't extract fully, so I can't confirm which features come with which tier.

**Pricing**

| | Resend | Postmark |
|---|---|---|
| Free | 3,000/mo (100/day cap), 3 domains | 100/mo |
| ~10k emails/mo | $20 (Pro includes 50k) | $15 (Basic) or $16.50 (Pro) |
| ~50k emails/mo | $20 | About $87 on Basic (10k plus 40k overage at $1.80/1k), or about $69 on Pro |
| 100k emails/mo | $35 | About $180 on Pro, rough math from the listed overage |
| Overage per 1,000 | $0.90 down to $0.46 | $1.80 / $1.30 / $1.20 |
| Dedicated IP | $30/mo, Scale plan only ($90+), for senders over 3,000/day | $50/mo per IP, Pro or higher, intended for 300k+/mo |
| Retention | 30 days | 45 days, extendable to 365 days on Pro or higher |

The 50k and 100k Postmark figures are my own arithmetic from the listed overage rates. Postmark may offer volume tiers that weren't on the page.

**Deliverability**

- **Both:** DKIM, SPF and DMARC, automatic suppression lists, detailed bounce data, and multi-region sending.
- **Resend:** Deliverability insights on every plan, with personalized deliverability help from Pro. Dedicated IPs include automatic warmup and monitoring.
- **Postmark:** Vetted IPs, a public status page with delivery statistics, and open and link tracking. It also sells DMARC monitoring ($14/mo per domain). It claims delivery up to 4x faster than other providers, which I couldn't verify.

**Why Resend**

- It costs much less at volume, and the free tier is far more usable.
- The Pro plan has no daily cap.

**Why Postmark**

- Its reputation rests on strict policies and a long record of fast, reliable inbox placement for transactional mail. That comes from my background knowledge, not from the pricing pages.
- It keeps logs longer, and its DMARC monitoring is a paid add-on.
- It is probably the safer choice when a single delayed email is costly, such as password resets, 2FA codes or receipts.

I'd start on Resend's free or Pro tier. If you see delivery delays or spam-folder problems, switching is cheap, because you only change the API integration and DNS records. Check independent deliverability tests before committing if mail-critical delivery is the priority.

Sources: [Resend pricing](https://resend.com/pricing), [Postmark pricing](https://postmarkapp.com/pricing)
